name: Basileus Raelius
original_name: ヴァシレウス･ラリウス
source:
The current head of the historic <House Larius> and Artesia's uncle.

He is extremely serious and has a strong sense of responsibility, but also possesses a ruthlessness that makes him willing to sacrifice anything for the sake of his convictions.
He adopted the young Theodore and Chrisneia, gave them the surname Stratos, and instilled martial arts and education in them.

At Sephiroth, he serves as the person in charge of the <Rod of Asclepius> project, providing full backup for Theodor.
